'''Xeleste''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was stationed at the [[Leth Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where she asked an Imperial to take down the [[Aegis Company]].<ref name="TOR" />
